Title: View trends of client-side metrics across test runs in Azure Load Testing

Body.Content:
Using Azure Load Testing, you can now track trends in client-side metrics from your last ten test runs. This helps you see if your performance is getting better or worse.

You can also pick one test run as a baseline and compare the recent metrics to it. This way, you can tell if your performance meets your expectations.

Learn more about client-side metric trends in Azure Load Testing.
